title: common/freshness
description: Freshness block for observation-bearing references. All three fields are required: freshness-bearing consumers treat missing freshness as a load failure, never as 'fresh' (P13).

observed_tick.description: Game tick at which the referenced state was observed.

observed_utc.description: RFC 3339 wall-clock time of the observation.

max_age_ticks.description: Maximum age in game ticks before the referenced state is stale.
